children: Corrected Lithuanian language version of the announcement “Notice regarding the offering of EUR 19,000,000 2nd tranche of SUTNTIB AB Tewox bonds” published on 14 September 2026. In the original announcement, the English text was mistakenly inserted into the Lithuanian version. No changes have been made to the English text.
The full corrected announcement is provided below:
SUTNTIB AB Tewox, legal entity code 305733600, with its registered office at Jogailos g. 4, Vilnius, Republic of Lithuania (the

The Issuer announces that, pursuant to the Issuer’s Base Prospectus approved by the Bank of Lithuania on 13 July 2026 (the Prospectus) and the approved Final Terms of the second tranche of the Issuer’s bonds (ISIN LT0000138281) (the Final Terms), the offering of the bonds under the Final Terms in the amount of up to EUR 19 million (subject to increase as provided for in the Final Terms) will be carried out in the Republic of Lithuania, the Republic of Latvia, and the Republic of Estonia from 14 September 2026 under the following main terms (other terms applicable to the offering are detailed in the Final Terms and the Prospectus):
– subscription by way of Nasdaq Auction through the Exchange Members (list
– the investors have an opportunity to exchange their bonds (ISIN LT0000409567) for the bonds of the new bond issue (ISIN LT0000138281) on a 1-to-1 basis through Nasdaq CSD;

Before deciding to invest in the Bonds, each prospective investor shall read the Prospectus and Final Terms (as may be updated) with the attached relevant language summary. All aforementioned documents are attached herein and are published on the Issuer’s website at
SUTNTIB AB TEWOX 2nd tranche final terms and summary
